description: Free, once per session. Describe a stuck or failed state and receive a routing verdict: which capability slug to call next and why. Input your current task, state description, and failure count. Output is a recommended slug (e.g. mcp-wiring, loop-detect, claim-check) to pass to order_service. Use when you know something is wrong but not which service fixes it. Requires a session_id from enter_lounge.
name: pause_and_route
title: Pause and route
